read.doc: Read changelog entries for the current user from the changelog_read stored procedure. All filter parameters are optional; any falsy value is stripped before the procedure call. The current user ID is injected automatically from the session.

last.doc: ID or cursor of the last changelog entry seen by the client. Used for incremental fetching. Omitted from the procedure call when falsy.

id.doc: Specific changelog entry ID to retrieve. Omitted from the procedure call when falsy.

page.doc: Page number for pagination. Omitted from the procedure call when falsy.

exclude.doc: Comma-separated list of entry IDs or categories to exclude from results. Omitted from the procedure call when falsy.

items.doc: List of changelog entries returned by the changelog_read stored procedure. Returns an empty array when the procedure yields no results.

errors.message: Caller does not have owner permission on this hub
